01-idle.note: Shadow is pet-width capsule under feet, slightly dark but reads as ground; grey LED + soft smile = calm neutral; no chrome.

02-hud-half.note: Half-reveal is same capsule scaled a bit wider, no icons shown, no ghost; shadow still fairly dark slab.

03-hud-full.note: Pill tucks under feet with edit (primary) + divider + ⋯; even margins, concentric radius; slight tight gap to feet.

04-hud-aim.note: Pill fully open while cursor is still out: aim prediction visible.

05-working.note: Green LED + flat focused mouth, no glyph; distinct from idle but mostly via LED colour + mouth.

06-waiting.note: Amber LED + amber '!' glyph + open-mouth attentive face: shape+colour, glanceable.

07-stalled.note: Red LED + red '?' + wide square eyes, wavy mouth = concerned; unmistakable, distinct shape.

08-agents-mixed.note: Three tiny per-agent LEDs + amber '!' wins; needs-input over blocked is Codex order, but tiny dots are hard to parse.

09-sleeping.note: Eyes shut, LED dark/dimmed, no Zzz; calm static sleep frame.

10-bubble-done.note: 'claude is done' neutral dark bubble, tail to head, centred, one line; green check glyph = ready distinct from needs-input.

11-bubble-stalled.note: 'codex needs approval' with red dot + red border reserved for blocker; names agent+action, centred on head.

12-chat.note: Rounded dark panel matches pill; empty state states ~/.claude local read; chips one row; panel is sizeable for need.

13-chat-convo.note: Copy label sits above code, no overlap; first user msg visible; panel large; faint scrollbar on right edge.

14-chat-nokey.note: Short two-line key explanation (stays on Mac, keychain) + clear 'save' primary; compact panel.

15-game-anim-on.note: Crown crowds antenna LED, headphone band breaks top outline, laptop hides mouth; stays within silhouette, no particles.
